title: Fake Alumni Mentor
scenario: An alumni mentor asks for your passport scan to arrange an overseas internship.

answers.A: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.B: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.C: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.
answers.D: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.

explanation: Fake Alumni Mentor: the trap is to collect private data, images, or documents under pressure. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Mentorship does not require identity documents upfront.
